exact_holds.reason: Exact legal-port/protocol mapping of dense switch matrix Table13.3.5-1 cannot be established from extracted text alone; page image retrieval unavailable.
Full ANSI/VITA 65.0 and 65.1 source-native slot and ANS definitions uninspected.
Underlying VITA66 optical connector specifications uninspected; optical aperture geometry not independently certified.
Separate edition-specific DSDM, IDL and six OpenAPI originals remain unread and are not equivalent to AMPS physical-port grammar.
§13.3.5 text explicitly points to Table13.3.4-3 while introducing Table13.3.5-2; unresolved original cross-reference mismatch.
Switch §13.3.5 opening describes Payload PICP despite the switch-specific figures/table; printed terminology retained.
Original note describes values as format examples; no invented required protocol support or device conformance.
X matrix cells are source Not Applicable, not an affirmative dash choice or current hardware capability.
Two complete example strings print -j- without selecting a specific deployed dash; do not turn -j into known -0/-3/-4/-5.
3U DP versus 3U EP physical switch functions and their named DP/EP/CP card roles must not be conflated.
3U MODA3 and 6U MODA6 source strings/slot design have different physical form factors; no common mandated chassis.
No actual card, switch, port, active fiber, firmware, manufacturer product or conformance result inspected.
Data-plane and expansion-plane transport field definitions are not CSAPI DataStream or observation-report paths.
No new DIM field/class/cardinality or CSAPI Profile requirement accepted through this donor comparison.
§13.3.6 VITA66 connector subclause excluded, except source title used to mark stopping boundary.
All 19 §13.3.4 payload matrix/printed anomaly/companion holds remain open; no implicit resolution by switch review.
Later 2025 SOSA S251 Snapshot 3 has not been compared for changed switch PICPs or dash options.
